description: Essential controls against overfitting and data leakage

checks.name: no_candidate_a_test_or_phase6_access
checks.details: Zero access, reads, transforms, or evaluations on Candidate A Test or Phase 6 holdout.

checks.name: no_validation_outcomes_used_for_calibrator_fitting
checks.details: Platt calibrator parameters (a, b) fitted exclusively on 3,278 Train OOF predictions.

checks.name: no_validation_outcomes_used_for_threshold_selection
checks.details: Operating threshold tau=0.2250 selected on Train OOF candidate grid (201 points) before policy freeze.

checks.name: parent_job_separation_across_folds
checks.details: Candidate A Train partitioned into 5 folds with zero parent job overlap across training and held-out folds.

checks.name: single_oof_prediction_per_train_window
checks.details: Exactly 3,278 out-of-fold rows generated per seed with unique fold identifiers.

checks.name: consistent_fold_ids_and_entity_grouping
checks.details: Fold assignments sealed in fold_assignments.csv and reused across all three random seeds.

checks.name: preprocessing_fit_discipline
checks.details: Multi-resolution causal feature representation frozen from Phase 7N without re-normalization or leakage.

checks.name: frozen_model_architecture_and_margin_rule
checks.details: MultiResolutionLSTMClassifier with AsymmetricCriticalMarginLoss (weights=[1,2,2], lambda=0.10, margin=0.50) preserved.

checks.name: finite_and_bounded_calibrator_outputs
checks.details: All q_fail values strictly within [0.0, 1.0], no NaN, Inf, or negative probabilities.

checks.name: metric_label_and_denominator_integrity
checks.details: Denominators verified: 20 episodes, 49 Critical windows, 48 Warning windows, 49 pure-normal entities, 560 Normal windows.

checks.name: policy_freeze_prior_to_validation_evaluation
checks.details: frozen_operating_policy.json sealed with SHA-256 before computing Candidate A Validation metrics.

checks.name: deterministic_policy_reproducibility
checks.details: Re-applying frozen decision rule produces identical classifications (0 discrepancy across 657 rows).

checks.name: prediction_window_alignment
checks.details: validation_predictions.csv maps 1-to-1 with Candidate A Validation metadata timestamps and entity IDs.

checks.name: no_post_hoc_threshold_modification
checks.details: Policy threshold remained strictly tau=0.2250; no threshold search or tuning performed on Validation.
